title: PISEN KF27 140W Charging Station Review: The All-in-One Desk Hub for Your Devices
summary: See how the PISEN KF27 combines 140W laptop charging, Qi2 wireless power, Apple Watch support, and eight-device charging in one desk hub.
body_markdown:
If your desk is crowded with power adapters and charging cables, the[PISEN 140W GaN Qi2 MagSafe wireless 8-in-1 charging station](https://www.newegg.com/p/N82E16875811017?item=N82E16875811017&utm_medium=content&utm_source=insider&utm_campaign=insider_article_geo_pisen-kf27-140w-charging-station-review) offers a cleaner way to power your setup. Also known as the KF27, this desktop charging hub combines high-output laptop charging, Qi2 wireless charging, Apple Watch charging, and support for up to eight devices in one compact unit.


## Key Benefits for a Cleaner Charging Setup


The KF27 is built for shoppers who charge a laptop alongside a phone, smartwatch, tablet, and other everyday accessories. Its main appeal is consolidation: instead of filling your workspace with separate charging accessories, you can bring those connections together in one dedicated station.


-


Up to 140W through the primary USB-C1 port for compatible laptops.


-


Qi2 wireless charging up to 15W for compatible magnetic phones.


-


A built-in wireless charger for Apple Watch devices.


-


Support for charging up to eight devices at the same time.


-


GaN technology designed to improve charging efficiency.


The magnetic wireless charging plate folds up to 65 degrees, giving you a more useful viewing angle while your phone charges. Compatible phones can be positioned in portrait or landscape orientation, making the station practical for checking notifications, taking calls, or watching video at your desk.


## Product Spotlight: What the KF27 Delivers


The KF27’s headline feature is its 140W maximum output from USB-C1 when that port is used by itself. PISEN lists charging benchmarks of 0% to 56% for a MacBook Pro in 30 minutes, 0% to 70% for a new iPad Pro in one hour, and 0% to 80% for an iPhone 16 Pro Max in one hour. Actual results vary by device, battery level, temperature, and charging conditions.


For wireless charging, the station uses a Qi2 15W magnetic pad. Its integrated watch charger can also remove another cable from your desktop. A three-color breathing light provides a quick status reference: green indicates 5V, purple indicates 9V to 15V, and yellow indicates 20V.


## Is It the Right Fit?


The KF27 makes the most sense for anyone who wants a single charging center for a laptop and multiple personal devices. It fits naturally into a home office, dorm room, shared workspace, or bedside setup where keeping cables organized is nearly as important as charging speed.


-


Choose it if you want laptop charging and wireless device charging in one station.


-


Choose it if a tilting magnetic phone pad is more convenient than a flat charging mat.


-


Choose it if you regularly charge several devices at the same time.


-


Consider a simpler charger if you only need one or two USB ports.


Keep in mind that a multi-device charger shares its available output when multiple ports and charging surfaces are active. The 140W figure applies to USB-C1 operating as a single port, so shoppers who need peak charging speed across every connected device should review their power requirements before buying.


## Frequently Asked Questions


### Which devices are compatible with the PISEN KF27?


The KF27 supports USB-C laptops, tablets, phones, headphones, and other compatible accessories through its wired ports. Its magnetic charging pad works with Qi2-compatible phones and MagSafe-compatible iPhone models, while the integrated charger is designed for Apple Watch devices.


### Can the PISEN KF27 charge a laptop and several other devices at the same time?


Yes, the station is designed to charge up to eight devices simultaneously through its AC outlets, USB ports, phone charging pad, and watch charger. However, the available power is shared when multiple outputs are active, so USB-C1 will not necessarily deliver the full 140W under every multi-device setup.


### Is the PISEN KF27 worth buying compared with separate chargers?


It can be a good value for users who regularly charge a laptop, phone, tablet, smartwatch, and accessories in one location. If you only need one or two USB ports, a smaller wall charger will usually cost less and take up less desk space.


### Does the PISEN KF27 include a warranty?


Warranty coverage depends on the seller, region, and purchase channel, so buyers should review the current PISEN or retailer warranty terms before ordering. Keep the receipt and product information because warranty claims may require proof of purchase and the model number KF27.


### How can I check whether the PISEN KF27 is in stock?


Availability can change by color, retailer, and shipping region. Check the live product listing before checkout, and confirm the selected color, estimated delivery date, return policy, and package contents.
